messages:
anya: quick heads-up — deploybot scheduled an unpin for runtime v3.3 in canary (5% traffic) at 15:00 UTC. proposal: run a pinless canary for 1 hour, then evaluate telemetry. thoughts? :eyes:
ben: i'm +1 for a short pinless window, but we should require KV-cache warming fallback on failure. last time cold cache caused 3xx latency blips.
deploybot: deploybot: queued: unpin runtime=v3.3 -> runtime=v3.4-canary in us-west-2, target=5%. Start=15m. Rollback trigger: >2% error-rate or p50 latency increase >150ms over baseline for 5m. See /ops/run/1234
kai: what's the rollout hold logic? do we want canary->staged or canary->auto-unpin?
helen: recommend: 30m grace + alert to #eng-oncall, and a quick smoke test after 10m. if smoke fails, rollback immediately.
jm-qa: adding smoke script below. please run locally against canary:
```
curl -sS https://canary-api.us-west-2.redwood.ai/health | jq '.ok'
for i in {1..50}; do curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" https://canary-api.us-west-2.redwood.ai/v1/completions | jq '.latency'; done
```
anya: also note SDK 2.7 has a minor wire change; runtime v3.4 expects both 2.6 and 2.7. confirm QA validated both in staging.
ben: checked staging with 2.6 & 2.7 yesterday — all green. small tokenization diff seen only with longseq tests, but perf unaffected.
opsbot: perf baseline (us-west-2 canary) p50=85ms p95=230ms error=0.12%. Will post telemetry after startwindow.
anya: plan then: start in 15m, pinless window 1h, smoke at +10m, oncall notified, rollback criteria per deploybot. i'll draft release note blurb and add to the rollout doc.
helen: add note to release notes: 'runtime v3.4: C++ kernel patch, compatible with SDK 2.6/2.7; pinless canary 1h — monitor tokenization regressions for longseq workloads.'
ben: :thumbsup:
deploybot: deploybot: unpin started. canary=5% in us-west-2. run id=run-17888. monitoring hooks active.
anya: monitoring shows 1st minute clean. will check longseq sims at +12m.
